mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recruit_notice (fair_id, writer_id, title, content, image_url, recruit_deadline) VALUES (#{fairId}, #{writerId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{imageUrl}, #{recruitDeadline}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = #{title}, content = #{content}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, recruit_deadline = #{recruitDeadline}, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT recruit_notice_id, fair_id, writer_id, title, content, image_url, created_at, updated_at, recruit_deadline FROM recruit_notice WHERE fair_id = #{fairId}

SELECT bs.booth_slot_id AS boothSlotsId, bs.slot_number AS slotNumber, bs.price AS price, bs.pos_x AS posX, bs.pos_y AS posY, bs.width AS width, bs.height AS height, h.hall_id AS hallId, h.name AS hallName, h.floor_plan_image_url AS floorPlanImageUrl, CASE ( SELECT a.status FROM application_slot aps JOIN application a ON a.application_id = aps.application_id WHERE aps.booth_slot_id = bs.booth_slot_id AND a.status IN ('PENDING_REVIEW', 'PAYMENT_PENDING', 'CONFIRMED') LIMIT 1 ) WHEN 'CONFIRMED' THEN 'CONFIRMED' WHEN 'PENDING_REVIEW' THEN 'PENDING' WHEN 'PAYMENT_PENDING' THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'AVAILABLE' END AS status, ( SELECT b.name FROM application_slot aps JOIN application a ON a.application_id = aps.application_id JOIN business b ON b.business_id = a.business_id WHERE aps.booth_slot_id = bs.booth_slot_id AND a.status = 'CONFIRMED' LIMIT 1 ) AS businessName FROM booth_slots bs JOIN halls h ON bs.hall_id = h.hall_id WHERE h.fair_id = #{fairId} AND bs.is_active = TRUE ORDER BY bs.slot_number
